title: Rico's Cherry SMP
description:
Rico's Take on the Cherry SMP modpack!
This modpack is perfect for anybody that wants to have a rebranding minecraft experience!
body:
This is Rico's take on the Cherry SMP modpack!
If you want a refreshing experience of Minecraft, this is the choice!

**_Playing with friends on a private server is recommended to get the most out of the modpack!_**

**This is not a vanilla+ modpack**

This modpack adds a lot of new features, its not the place to have a vanilla type experience!

This modpack adds optimisation aswell as technical and quality of life mods!

Hope you enjoy this modpdack!
